forecast-period.text: A high pressure system centred over SA will remain near stationary, slowly drifting to the southeast to be located west of Tasmania on Saturday, with a ridge expected to remain over South Australia. A trough over QLD pushes into the far northeast of SA from later Saturday through to later Monday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Morning fog about the west coast, Eyre Peninsula and part of the agricultural area. Possible patchy morning frost about the northern agricultural area or south of the Pastoral districts. Isolated light showers about the southern agricultural area, most likely about windward coasts and ranges. Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms in the far northwest corner during the afternoon or evening. Maximum temperatures below average, grading to near average about the southern agricultural area. East to southeasterly winds, although west to southwesterly about the southeast until evening.

Morning fog about the the Eyre Peninsula and about the agricultural area. Isolated light showers about the agricultural areas, most likely about windward coasts and ranges. Showers about the northwest, with possible thunderstorms about the far northwest. Maximum temperatures below average, tending near average about the southern agricultural area. Southeast to northeasterly winds.

Possible morning fog about the southeast and southwest. Areas of frost inland about the agricultural area and south of the pastoral districts. Isolated showers about the north and west. Maximum temperatures below average. Southeast to northeasterly winds.

text.p: Possible morning fog on and east of the ranges. Showers about the North East Pastoral and Flinders districts possibly extending into the Mid North and parts of Eyre Peninsula, tending to rain at times in the northeast. Maximum temperatures slightly below average in the north, grading to above average about the agricultural areas. Northeast to northerly winds, freshening in the far west later.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Monday: Broad falls of less than 3 mm across much of the state, with isolated falls of 2 to 5 mm about the agricultural area and falls of 5 to 15 mm about the Pastoral and Flinders districts. Isolated falls of 15 to 30 mm possible about the north.
